compiler.scope: Carries per-invocation source PC and requested target into absent-instruction transfer hooks; rejects unclassified unterminated blocks. Gives asynchronous hypercall return faults source and reason. Limits each decode read to exact manifest instruction bytes, disabling cross-instruction call/pop fusion. Adds audit hooks and source-aware ordinary call-return guards to a local copy of pinned TraceLifter.cpp. Exact optional no-normal-return contracts reject ordinary returns; conditional call categories fail until independently validated. Normalizes implicit x87 FOP immediates from exact manifest opcode bytes, preserving all 11 bits. Existing Remill executable and libraries untouched. No input-code execution.
